segments.caption: A yellow excavator operates on a partially submerged, icy or muddy bank, using its bucket to assist a large group of people—many appearing to be migrants or refugees—crossing a body of water. The crowd gathers closely on the edge, some pushing or pulling toward the machine, while others wait their turn. The scene unfolds under an overcast sky, suggesting a cold, urgent, and possibly dangerous crossing, with the excavator serving as a makeshift aid to help the group
A group of people, many carrying bags and backpacks, are carefully disembarking from a small, crowded boat onto a muddy or rocky shore, with the water visible behind them.
A group of men are being helped onto a yellow Komatsu excavator from a small boat in the water, suggesting a rescue or evacuation operation near a concrete pier.

Two yellow excavators operate in shallow water near a concrete pier, with one lifting a group of people out of the water using its bucket, while the other excavator is positioned nearby, suggesting a coordinated rescue or extraction operation.

Two yellow excavators operate in turbulent, icy water, their mechanical arms and buckets maneuvering through the frothy waves. The camera zooms in on the heavy-duty bucket, highlighting its rugged, worn condition as it dips and lifts, before revealing the operator inside the cab, focused on the demanding task at hand.

A man in a dark jacket and jeans is seen inside the bucket of a large yellow excavator, positioned over turbulent water. He carefully maneuvers himself, standing up and stepping onto a metal plate at the base of the bucket, appearing to be either preparing to exit or adjusting his position on the moving machinery.
A person is being pulled from a turbulent body of water by a yellow excavator, with rescuers assisting from the bucket as waves crash around them.
Two men are riding in the bucket of a yellow excavator as it maneuvers over turbulent, foamy water, holding on tightly as the machine bobs and sways with the waves.
Three men are seen riding in the bucket of an excavator as it maneuvers over icy water and onto a rocky shore, eventually depositing them safely on land where other people are waiting.

A crowd gathers on a muddy riverbank as a yellow excavator operates near the water’s edge, its arm maneuvering around a large metal structure, suggesting a rescue or recovery effort involving people and heavy machinery.

A group of people are gathered on a muddy riverbank, and a yellow Komatsu excavator is positioned at the water's edge. The excavator's bucket is lowered into the water, and it is used to scoop up individuals from the turbulent water, bringing them to safety on the bank.
A person is rescued from icy water by a yellow Komatsu excavator, whose massive bucket lifts them safely from the turbulent, frozen surface.
A man in a black jacket and striped pants is being pulled from the jaws of a large yellow excavator by another person, with the snowy ground visible below.
A man is pulled from icy water by a rescue team using a large yellow excavator, with one rescuer holding him steady as he is hoisted out of the frigid water.
Three men are carefully maneuvered by a yellow Caterpillar excavator as it lifts them from turbulent, icy water and deposits them safely onto a rocky shore.

In a chaotic and urgent scene at what appears to be a border crossing or makeshift crossing point, a yellow excavator is being used to transport people—likely migrants or refugees—across a hazardous, rocky terrain. In the first frame, several individuals are seen huddled inside the excavator’s bucket, holding onto each other for safety. A crowd of people gathers on a snowy, icy shoreline, watching intently as a yellow Komatsu excavator maneuvers its bucket into the turbulent water. The excavator is actively used to rescue individuals who are being pulled from the icy water and lifted out of the bucket, with rescuers assisting them as they are brought to safety.
A yellow excavator's bucket is repeatedly dipped into and lifted from turbulent, foamy water, suggesting an ongoing dredging, salvage, or underwater excavation operation.

A person is seated inside the bucket of a yellow excavator, which is partially submerged in turbulent, icy water, as the machine appears to be maneuvering or operating in a frozen or partially frozen body of water.

A man in a black jacket and cap is inside the bucket of a yellow excavator, which is partially submerged in turbulent, icy water. He appears to be struggling or maneuvering within the confined space as the heavy machinery rocks, with the surrounding water churning violently around the bucket.
Two men are seen clinging to the bucket of a yellow excavator as it is maneuvered over turbulent, icy water, suggesting a perilous rescue or escape attempt.

A dramatic rescue unfolds as a yellow excavator, partially submerged in icy water, uses its bucket to lift and pull people to safety from a dangerous, icy environment. The excavator's arm maneuvers through the turbulent water, carefully scooping up individuals—some bundled in winter gear and carrying bags—before hauling them out of the perilous conditions and onto a safer, rocky shore. A chaotic and urgent evacuation unfolds as people, including an elderly woman, are hastily pulled from the cab of a large yellow Komatsu excavator by others, amid a crowded and tense scene on what appears to be a snowy or icy waterfront.
A group of people are evacuating from a flooded area, carrying luggage as they climb onto the bucket of a yellow Komatsu excavator for safety.

A person is seen inside the bucket of a yellow excavator, which is being lifted out of turbulent, foamy water. As the excavator's bucket rises, the individual clings to the interior structure, appearing to be rescued or maneuvered out of the water by the heavy machinery.
A person is rescued from icy water by being pulled into the bucket of a yellow excavator, where they are assisted by another individual before being secured.
Two people are rescued from icy water by a yellow Komatsu excavator, which lifts them from the frozen surface as onlookers watch from the shore.

Two yellow excavators operate in shallow water near a breakwater, actively engaged in a rescue or salvage operation. One excavator uses its bucket to lift and extract personal belongings—such as a suitcase—from the submerged or partially submerged structure. People are present on the structure, observing and assisting as the excavator carefully maneuvers the items out of the water, indicating a coordinated effort to recover possessions from a flooded or damaged area.

A group of migrants, many carrying luggage, are gathered on a muddy, rocky riverbank, waiting and being assisted by workers using heavy machinery to help them cross or transport their belongings across a shallow river, while a truck is parked nearby on the far side.

A rescue operation unfolds as a yellow excavator maneuvers across icy water to reach a person submerged or trapped beneath the ice. A crowd watches from the shore as the excavator’s bucket carefully lifts the individual, who is seen clinging to the machinery, out of the dangerous, turbulent water.
A person is being rescued from icy water by a yellow excavator, which carefully lifts them from the freezing surface and brings them to safety alongside another excavator on the shore.
Two yellow excavators operate in shallow water, actively working to dismantle or move a large, submerged structure, while a crowd of onlookers gathers on the far bank to observe the operation.
